name: implied_vs_realized_vol_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when VIX has spiked intraday but 20-minute realized volatility has not kept pace, market makers who sold calls into the fear spike are over-hedged short-delta and will buy the index to unwind as VIX begins to revert. We detect this regime by computing the intraday VRP (VIX/100 minus 20-min annualized realized vol) and z-scoring it over the trailing 60-minute window; when VRP z-score exceeds 1.5 and VIX's 5-minute rate-of-change turns negative (confirming the spike is reversing), NIFTY tends to drift upward 15-25 spot points over the following 30-90 seconds as dealer delta hedges unwind. The short leg fires when RV exceeds implied vol (VRP z-score < -1.5) with VIX rising, signaling complacency before a move.
core_signal_oneliner: Intraday variance risk premium z-score with VIX rate-of-change direction confirmation for dealer delta unwind
